reviewMethod: Full 1254 native image, full right and bottom return strips, lower-right corner, and complete repaired diagonal strip viewed at original pixel size.
findings: New rectangular ivory paving follows the canonical world layout and the real right/bottom finished context.
The initial native bevel differed from the bottom source and the first AI repair did not resolve its angle. They were not accepted as final.

A second AI inpaint redrew the entire lower-left diagonal strip. Complete generated contour is retained above y1120 and only matched lower endpoints transition to existing context. This removes the double edge without geometric warping.
Right return contours remain continuous, source beyond x1200 is exact, and bottom source beyond y1200 is exact.
No resize, geometric registration, tone adjustment or blur was applied.
New core, right return, and r08_c10 bottom return must be applied together after r04_c04 manifest.
limitations: Only this native patch and its returns are accepted locally. Full tile, exterior neighbor and city review are required.
